missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Ужас' is masculine and stays in the nominative as the subject of 'охватил'. 'Настоящий' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Ужас' is inanimate masculine, so its accusative matches the nominative as the object of 'почувствовал'. 'Внезапный' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Ужаса' is genitive after 'от', expressing the cause of his freezing.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Ужасу' is dative after 'поддалась', which governs that case, here in the negative.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Ужасе' is prepositional after 'в', marking the state they were in. 'Немом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.

missions.phrase: Она смотрела на экран с ужасом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Ужасом' is instrumental after 'с', describing the manner of watching.
Strategic focus: Nominative exclamation. 'Ужас' is nominative in the fixed exclamation 'какой ужас', expressing dismay. 'Какой' agrees in the masculine nominative.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Ужасы' is the accusative plural object of 'принесла'; inanimate, so it matches the nominative plural. 'Людям' is the dative plural recipient.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Ужасы' is the nominative plural subject of the impersonal construction. 'Войны' is genitive showing whose horrors they are.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Ужасах' is prepositional plural after 'об', marking the topic. 'Прошлого' is genitive showing whose horrors they are.
